title: Grateful Dead Live at County Fairgrounds on 1968-05-18
taper: Jorma masters with stage mics - unknown gen]

ai_review.summary: Fluctuating audience tape captures a high‑energy early‑68 set with blistering jams like Alligator, despite rough sound quality.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (aud) source that suffers from clipping, distortion and volume swings, making Pigpen’s vocals hard to hear. Musically the show shines – a wild, high‑octane early‑1968 performance with searing jams such as Alligator and the classic “Mountain Jam” riff that epitomizes the band’s pre‑Anthem‑of‑the‑Sun era.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers overwhelmingly praise the performance (5‑star ratings) and cite standout jams, while noting only moderate recording flaws that do not outweigh the musical strength.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bad quality with clipping/distortion; sound level fluctuates heavily; Pigpen’s vocal barely audible; overall listenable despite issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Raw, high‑energy early‑1968 set that leans heavily on extended jams and a wild, primal Dead vibe; the performance builds to an intense climax with feedback fading into a cymbal tap.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "pure electricity" on Alligator after drums.
